Backend: 8/8 pytest pass (engine ready, 8 voices with Orion p273 + Lyra p335, guest 401 on speak, authed WAV audio_base64 with 'frasberg-sovereign', immutable creator lore 'Frasberg Selassie / MR. CLAYTON-M. / BERNARD-EX. / FRASBERG INC', addresses user by name 'Frasberg Admin', memory vault deposit+recall across new sessions returns 'Zeus' correctly). Frontend: chat header shows 'Luchii' (no 'Luchii Chat'), engine-status-badge 'Sovereign Engine Online', tone/voice/voice-picker/model/attach/live-voice controls present, model dropdown contains only Luchii-200M/1B/7B/70B (no Image/Video Creator), all 4 attach menu items work, Image Creator sets composer-mode-chip, voice-picker-panel opens with 8 voice-option rows, voice-preview-p335 triggers /api/voice/speak 200, voice-select-p335 toasts 'Luchii now speaks as Lyra', mobile 390px collapses to chat-header-menu-btn + chat-settings-btn with 0 horizontal overflow, dashboard quickstart cURL/Python/JS tabs all contain https://frasberg.com/api/v1/chat and NO 'emergentagent'.

minor.issue: System prompt in _extract_memory (server.py L187) instructs 'Extract at most ONE stable personal fact'. When user says 'Remember: my favorite mountain is Kilimanjaro AND my dog is Zeus' in a single message, only one fact is stored. Multi-fact deposits are silently dropped. Consider allowing extraction of up to 3-5 facts per message when the user uses the imperative 'Remember...'.

Occasionally the embedding is missing from the freshly inserted user_memories doc (observed 1/3 times) even though memory_vault.status is 'ready'. Non-blocking because _memory_context lazily backfills embeddings on next query, but worth logging why memory_vault.embed() returned None.

ui_bugs.issue: No data-testid="chat-header-title" attribute on the 'Luchii' header text. Visual value is correct ('Luchii', not 'Luchii Chat') but testid missing hinders regression testing.

issues: React hydration warning in console: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Renders correctly but produces client-side warning; the <option> labels probably contain an inner span (icon/badge). Should be plain text inside <option>.

action_items: Consider relaxing _extract_memory prompt to allow multiple facts when user explicitly says 'Remember...'
Add data-testid="chat-header-title" to the chat page header for testability
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:637 voice_speak falls back to OpenAI TTS ('audio/mp3', engine 'bridge') when sovereign is not ready. If backend is restarted the first ~40s of speak calls will return non-sovereign mp3 audio. Consider surfacing 503 'engine warming' instead so client can retry rather than getting a different engine.
server.py:213 _memory_context does N+1 embed calls when embeddings are missing (one embed per doc). If many missing, this blocks the chat SSE start. Consider batch-embedding.
memory_vault.py:44 embed() catches all exceptions and returns None silently. Add logger.warning with the fact snippet so failures are debuggable.
